study: Timber façade connection toolkit independent study
status: ILLUSTRATIVE EDUCATIONAL INPUTS, NOT FOR DESIGN

panel.actions_status: ASSUMED characteristic actions. No design combination or load factor inferred.

assumptions: Illustrative bolt penetration equals the 45 mm rail thickness; actual detail required.
One row of two bolts parallel to grain at 7d is an ASSUMED layout, not a fabrication drawing.
Force parallel to grain is an ASSUMED scalar lateral-fastener subcase. Actual three-dimensional bracket load path is UNVERIFIED.
Grade 4.6 ultimate strength is the explicit illustrative 400 MPa input supplied in the brief; product documentation remains required.
Rope contribution is deliberately neglected. Zero supplied axial resistance does not prove the product has zero axial capacity.
Service class 2 and short-term load duration are ASSUMED to illustrate kmod 0.9.
gamma_M 1.3 is a recommended connection value, not a verified current UK National Annex selection.
The optional steel-to-timber slip multiplier 2.0 is exposed, not automatically justified for an actual detail.

seismic.status: ILLUSTRATIVE. qa is an explicit input subject to the Table 4.4 category and detail conditions. nu is a recommended NDP exposed as input.
seismic.slot_assumption: Relative sliding demand is taken as the full assumed design interstorey drift, in both directions from a centred position. Slot length is shank diameter plus twice travel plus the explicit total installation allowance. This geometric illustration does not check bearing, bolt clearance, end distances or resistance.

fire.scope: Isolated unprotected solid-softwood stud under standard-fire idealisation. One face reduces the 145 mm depth. The insulated façade assembly and protected members are outside scope. No fire-resistance time rating or assembly classification is inferred.

racking.scope: Only a simplified Method A panel subcheck. Actual nail/OSB resistance, edge detailing, anchorage and complete applicability must be established. It does not assess out-of-plane wind resistance or the whole façade.

required_before_design_claim: Actual timber, board, fastener and bracket product documentation
Bracket geometry, bolt direction and verified load paths, including out-of-plane wind and gravity
All spacing, end and edge dimensions
Applicable action combinations and design shear demand
Manufacturer ETA and design capacity for anchors in the actual existing concrete
Explicit bracket load shares for per-bracket seismic demand
Racking fastener resistance, panel geometry, tie-down and fixing applicability
Design fire actions and the actual fire-exposure/assembly assessment
Applicable standards edition and National Annex selections
